adjudication_note: Round 2 of the execution review found `IR` tagged as Information Ratio in tax context: 3 of the 7 isolated `IR` occurrences in the corpus mean Imposto de Renda (DARF, 'IR Come-Cotas', 'tributação do IR'). The fix is not to suppress the form — it is to model the sense that was missing. Adding income tax as a concept that also claims `IR` lets the importer's collision demoter make BOTH ambiguous, which is what the corpus actually is. Same technique that fixed entity.class; the difference is that here one side of the collision did not exist yet, which is exactly why the demoter could not help before.

concepts.def: The tax levied on investment income and capital gains.
The Brazilian federal revenue collection form used to pay tax due.
Tax collected by the paying entity before the investor receives the amount.
The profit realised when an asset is sold above its acquisition cost.
The Brazilian tax on financial operations, levied on short-horizon redemptions.
